title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Three more shapes of Kotlin header were read as a finished declaration, so the class ended on its first line and its members were listed at the top level of the Outline. What was 211 entries two releases ago is now 3.

highlights.title: A default lambda is not a body
highlights.description: sealed class State(init: Builder.() -> Unit = {}) opened and closed its depth on the header itself, and all 42 members of one class hung outside it.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A brace inside a parameter list is never the body. The empty lambda of a default argument was counted as the class body opening and closing at once.

A header that goes on with constructor, with a supertype list, or with a where clause is read to its end. open class Foo on one line and constructor(...) on the next is what ktlint produces once the header is long.
An annotation between the class name and its constructor belongs to the header, not to whatever follows. The two readings of an annotation now depend on whether a class header is still open.
Folding a file costs what it did before: the next line is read only where the answer is about to be returned, not on every line.
